environment.description: Pod deployed in namespace 'stream-processing' with a Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy. The policy spec uses a combination of egress rules: allows TCP to Kafka broker CIDR (10.0.32.0/24) on ports 9092-9094, allows DNS resolution to kube-dns (UDP/53), and applies a default-deny egress posture via a baseline policy with an empty egress array. The L3/L4 filter entries are compiled into eBPF datapath maps on the node, meaning even if the process attempts raw socket connections, the kernel-level enforcement drops packets to 169.254.169.254/32 before they leave the veth pair. Additionally, the node's iptables FORWARD chain has a Cilium-inserted rule at position 1 that jumps to CILIUM_FORWARD which only permits flows matching BPF policy verdicts.

config.imds_access: blocked at datapath level - no egress rule permits 169.254.169.254/32
